definitions.explanation: Indicates any and all locations without restriction. Used to express that something exists everywhere or that one can go to any place.

examples.japanese: どこにでも⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧⟦{店|みせ}→店：00497_mise⟧だ。
examples.english: It's a store you can find anywhere.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦パス→パス：00340_pasu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦あれば→ある：00006_aru⟧、どこにでも⟦{行|い}ける→行く：00119_iku⟧。
examples.english: With this pass, you can go anywhere.

examples.japanese: ⟦コンビニ→コンビニ：01081_konbini⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧どこにでも⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、⟦{買|か}い{物|もの}→買い物：00853_kaimono⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{困|こま}らない→困る：00861_komaru⟧。
examples.english: Convenience stores are everywhere, so you never have trouble shopping.

notes:
Composed of ⟦どこ→どこ：00539_doko⟧ (where) + ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ (location particle) + ⟦でも→でも：00925_demo⟧ (even/any). Functions as an adverb meaning "at/to any place" or "everywhere." A natural combination of interrogative + ⟦でも→でも：00925_demo⟧ that creates an inclusive meaning.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- どこにでも⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧: to be found everywhere, ubiquitous
- どこにでも⟦{行|い}ける→行く：00119_iku⟧: can go anywhere
- どこにでも⟦{売|う}っている→売る：00906_uru⟧: sold everywhere

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- どこにでも⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧: an ordinary/unremarkable person (lit. a person you'd find anywhere)
- どこにでも⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧⟦{話|はなし}→話：01496_hanashi⟧: a common story

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦どこ→どこ：00539_doko⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧: anywhere (location of action) — similar but emphasizes where an action takes place
- ⟦{至|いた}る{所|ところ}→至る所：15861_itarutokoro⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧: everywhere — more literary expression
- {何処|どこ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧: everywhere (with positive verb); nowhere (with negative verb)
